display.purpose: Two-part hero heading; responsive sizes and second-line ratios remain in DESIGN.md and landing.css.

intro.purpose: Short API explanation inside the green field.

body.purpose: Open FAQ answers; not the inherited base size.

base.purpose: The later .relay-app size and line-height win for the public root; component and Hosted structural rules remain more specific.

workspace-heading.purpose: Fixed 28px operating hierarchy; not the public display ramp.

workspace-title.purpose: Common card and analytics headings; local technical/detail headings retain their own sizes.

workspace-label.purpose: 40px actions, rising to 44px on phones; line-height follows the original button family.

workspace-navigation.purpose: The direct span retains structural 13px despite the 12px button declaration; weight 450, selected 600.

workspace-metric.purpose: 20px/24px, weight 550, tracking -.025em: .overview-metrics strong beside its label, without a card or fixed-height cell.

workspace-metric-mobile.purpose: 18px/24px at viewport max-width 639px, in an open two-column summary beneath the title and filters.

chart-summary.purpose: 23px/550 summary in the recomposed overview chart cards.

chart-summary-mobile.purpose: 20px at viewport max-width 639px; catalog phone titles also use this size step.

usage-metric.purpose: 26px/32px, weight 550, tracking -.025em, in the primary row of the joined Usage summary.

usage-metric-compact.purpose: 22px/28px at relay-page container max-width 800px; the primary grid becomes two columns and the lower sections stack.

usage-metric-mobile.purpose: 20px/26px with overflow wrapping at viewport max-width 639px; exact cost amounts and uncertainty hints remain intact.

usage-detail-label.purpose: 11px/16px secondary-ink labels in the joined lower row, not an uppercase caption.

usage-detail-value.purpose: 14px/20px, weight 550, for token totals and speed values across desktop and phone layouts.

balance-value.purpose: 40px/1.2, weight 500, on the functional pine balance field; actual account data only.

balance-value-mobile.purpose: 36px at 639px while retaining the pine field and flat cream action.

workspace-note.purpose: 12px/1.7 from the final content layer; also establishes the deliberate supporting-copy size step.

table-heading.purpose: 11px/1.6, weight 500, shared by request, catalog, owner and payment tables.

table-body.purpose: 12px/1.65 with tabular numeric presentation in the common data-table family.

empty-heading.purpose: 32px/1.2, weight 500, in the left-aligned bounded empty state.

empty-heading-mobile.purpose: 26px at 639px; the branded state wordmark also uses the 26px step.

state-heading.purpose: 40px/1.15, weight 500, reducing to 32px on phones; independent hosted-entry typography remains unchanged.

dialog-title.purpose: Sentence-case 18px title, including the request dialog override; 16px on phones.

request-model.purpose: 22px/1.4, weight 600, tracking -.02em; leading model identity beside execution status, reducing to 20px at viewport max-width 639px.

request-charge.purpose: 22px/28px, weight 600, tracking -.02em; exact posted charge first in DOM and reading order, reducing to 20px on phones without compacting the amount.

request-timing.purpose: 18px/28px, weight 500, tracking -.02em; the three quieter timing values following charge on both desktop and phone layouts.

request-token-total.purpose: 18px/28px, weight 600, tracking -.02em; left-aligned beside its label and directly above the two open token columns.

entry-heading.purpose: Supporting unavailable entry: 48px, reducing to 36px at 700px.

code.purpose: Workspace code and keyboard text; no new global code-size rule.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Regular landing actions and joined language menu; replaces the shared hard keycap shadow only on the landing.

shadows.name: hero-action-lift
shadows.purpose: Cream Start action against the pine field.

shadows.name: flag-edge
shadows.purpose: Edge definition for the small SVG flag.

shadows.name: hosted-control-lift
shadows.purpose: Workspace actions, not panels, sidebar rows or tabs.

shadows.name: hosted-overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Hosted dialogs, notifications and option lists.

motion.name: control-movement
motion.purpose: Button press and primary arrow movement; no transform under reduced motion.

motion.name: theme-icon
motion.purpose: Theme icon transform and opacity; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: request-mint
motion.purpose: First bundle request stroke, dashoffset to -100.

motion.name: request-lifecycle
motion.purpose: Initial state and whenever offscreen, document-hidden or reduced-motion is requested; reduced-motion CSS also removes animation.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: Public native browser anchor navigation; reduced motion uses auto. Hosted scrolls its existing content region natively.

motion.name: hosted-navigation-colors
motion.purpose: Quiet sidebar background and foreground transitions; no decorative traffic in Hosted.

motion.name: hosted-reduced-motion
motion.value: transition: none !important; animation: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important
motion.purpose: Applied to the Hosted subtree and pseudo-elements under prefers-reduced-motion; press transforms are also removed.

motion.name: hosted-notification-state
motion.purpose: Unread notification bells retain semantic color without the inherited nudge animation.

narrative.overview:
A connection is expressed through precise, interlaced line bundles rather than a dashboard simulation. Pine green carries the public opening, workspace navigation and selected functional fields; warm paper and charcoal carry reading and operating surfaces. Golos Text and flat, quiet public/workspace controls keep the geometry approachable without textile textures or decorative 3D objects. Hosted page bodies use compact joined summaries and task-shaped compositions; owner inventory and pool use the requested Desktop-inspired card structure, adapted to Hosted controls and available source data. The marketing hero and moving traffic stay on the public landing.

This system covers the public `/` at `.landing.landing-home`, customer `/app/*` and owner `/admin/*` workspaces at `.relay-app.hosted-app`, their dialogs/help/empty states, and the separate `.relay-app.landing.hosted-entry` supporting entry. Desktop and backend behavior remain outside scope. The accepted directions live in `.impeccable/surfaces/src-features-landing-landingpage-tsx.md` and `.impeccable/surfaces/src-features-app-hostedapp-tsx.md`; the Hosted extension preserves the approved landing rather than replacing it.
keyCharacteristics: A green field with exact, three-bundle vector geometry.
Pine workspace navigation with one cream selected row.
Warm light surfaces and neutral charcoal dark surroundings.
Locally hosted Golos Text with separate display and operating type ramps.
Constant-speed public request illustration; quiet account operations.
Compact joined summaries, open request-token columns and full-width resource rows.

rules.name: The Green Field Rule
rules.body: Pine green owns the public hero, workspace navigation and specific functional fields such as balance and configuration; keep general reading and data surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Pine Navigation Rule
rules.body: Keep the sidebar pine with cream selection and keyboard focus, pale-green secondary text and no outer right border; navigation aliases reuse the pine family without changing billing fields.

rules.name: The Pine Menu Rule
rules.body: Hosted option lists and their open triggers use pine with a persistent cream selected row. Pointer and keyboard activity use fill rather than outlines; closed-trigger borders do not brighten on hover or focus. Native focus indicators remain in system high contrast. Menus use shadow without an outer border, 12px corners, 6px padding and 40px rows, increasing to 44px on phones and coarse pointers. Preserve positioning, selection, dismissal and reduced motion. The public attached language strip is unchanged.

rules.name: The One Web Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the local Golos Text stack across Hosted web surfaces, with distinct public and operating ramps; Desktop remains outside this system.

rules.name: The Soft Control Rule
rules.body: Keep information panels flat; use diffuse control lift and a separate overlay lift, with no hard keycap edge on press.

rules.name: The Single-Row Filter Rule
rules.body: At 1120px of content width, Usage shows all seven selectors and search in one row with a conditional reset. Below that width, the same controls return to the extra-filter disclosure without losing values. Use short trigger labels, full option names and a visible reset focus target; close popups when their triggers become hidden.

rules.name: The Compact Summary Rule
rules.body: Keep Overview counts inline beneath its shared title/filter header, without a separate metrics card or analytics heading. Usage groups its headline numbers in a shared surface, with token and speed details in its lower row; request-detail metrics and token columns remain open rather than recreating nested Desktop panels.

rules.name: The Measured Chart Rule
rules.body: Hosted charts use a 204px token plot and 164px supporting plots, 192px/152px on phones. Use quiet dashed guides, distinct restrained series colours and readable display-only ceilings. Keep integer request ticks, microUSD money precision, missing-data gaps, zero observations and partial intervals. Remove duplicate right axes; percentage retains 0–100%. Toggle series without changing totals. One chart focus stop and a shared arrowless interval tooltip support keyboard, pointer and touch. Preserve the exact-data table and use a selected crosshair instead of an outer focus ring, except in system high contrast.

dos: Do extend the shared identity across Hosted web surfaces while preserving the approved landing and the Desktop/backend boundary.
Do use the effective light/dark cascade, local font assets and the public entry's three existing locales without implying a newly translated workspace.
Do keep four FAQ answers visible, compact flag controls and both existing cabinet-entry paths.
Do retain keyboard-visible focus, native scrolling and a complete reduced-motion presentation.
Do preserve customer/owner operations, accounting warnings, dev-only fixture isolation and detailed request information without redundant scaffold captions.
Do use each task's full Hosted page composition, including compact joined summaries, responsive chart pairs, resource rows and open request-token columns.
Do paginate long payment/request/group histories, keep totals scoped to the full filter and preserve uncertainty when condensing phone rows.
donts: Don't replace exact vector line bundles with raster illustrations, cloth textures or decorative 3D objects.
Don't present illustrative request motion as live activity or add invented prices, metrics, testimonials or availability.
Don't promote overridden landing, structural Desktop or legacy dialog declarations into the Hosted web system.
Don't add wheel interception, scroll snapping, hidden FAQ answers or a new navigation concept.
Don't add decorative traffic, animated notification bells or hero-scale typography to operating screens.

Don't split the compact summaries into disconnected oversized metrics or a detached speed card, nest request-token boxes, force an always-single chart stack or restore the old Desktop page bodies under new colors.
